  depends_on = [module.lxc]

  triggers = {
    container_id        = var.container_id
    icloud_download_dir = var.icloud_download_dir
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false  # Run ansible directly on host

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Install immich-importer dependencies
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no
      vars:
        app_name: immich-importer
        icloud_download_dir: ${var.icloud_download_dir}

      tasks:
        # =====================================================================
        # Install System Packages
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Update apt cache
          ansible.builtin.apt:
            update_cache: yes
            cache_valid_time: 3600

        - name: Install base packages
          ansible.builtin.apt:
            name:
              - curl
              - unzip
              - cron
              - python3
            state: present

        # =====================================================================
        # Install uv (fast Python package manager)
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Check if uv is installed
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: which uv
          register: uv_check
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false

        - name: Install uv
          ansible.builtin.shell:
            cmd: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          when: uv_check.rc != 0

        # =====================================================================
        # Install icloudpd (iCloud Photo Downloader)
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Check if icloudpd is installed
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: which icloudpd
          register: icloudpd_check
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false
          environment:
            PATH: "/root/.local/bin:{{ ansible_env.PATH }}"

        - name: Install icloudpd via uv
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: /root/.local/bin/uv tool install icloudpd
          when: icloudpd_check.rc != 0
          environment:
            PATH: "/root/.local/bin:{{ ansible_env.PATH }}"

        # =====================================================================
        # Install rclone
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Check if rclone is installed
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: which rclone
          register: rclone_check
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false

        - name: Install rclone
          ansible.builtin.shell:
            cmd: curl -fsSL https://rclone.org/install.sh | bash
          when: rclone_check.rc != 0

        # =====================================================================
        # Install immich-go (latest release)
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Check if immich-go is installed
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: which immich-go
          register: immich_go_check
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false

        - name: Get latest immich-go version
          ansible.builtin.shell:
            cmd: curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/simulot/immich-go/releases/latest | grep tag_name | cut -d'"' -f4

          when: immich_go_check.rc != 0

        - name: Download and install immich-go

            src: "https://github.com/simulot/immich-go/releases/download/{{ immich_go_version.stdout }}/immich-go_Linux_x86_64.tar.gz"
            dest: /usr/local/bin
            remote_src: yes
            mode: '0755'
            include:
              - immich-go
          when: immich_go_check.rc != 0

        # =====================================================================
        # Create Required Directories
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Create required directories
          ansible.builtin.file:
            path: "{{ item }}"
            state: directory
            mode: '0755'
          loop:
            - /root/.config/rclone
            - /root/.icloudpd
            - "{{ icloud_download_dir }}"
            - /var/log

        - name: Display installation status
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg: "Dependencies installed successfully for {{ app_name }}"
  EOT

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "ansible_navigator_run" "configure_cron" {
  depends_on = [
    filesync_file.cloud_sync_script,
    filesync_file.icloud_sync_script,
    filesync_file.icloud_env,
    filesync_file.rclone_conf

  triggers = {
    container_id        = var.container_id
    cloud_schedule      = var.cloud_backup_schedule
    icloud_schedule     = var.icloud_sync_schedule
    icloud_sync_command = "sync-albums"  # Change this to trigger cron update
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false  # Run ansible directly on host
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Configure cron jobs for immich-importer
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no
      vars:
        app_name: immich-importer
        cloud_schedule: "${var.cloud_backup_schedule}"
        icloud_schedule: "${var.icloud_sync_schedule}"

      tasks:
        # =====================================================================
        # Configure Cron Jobs
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Add cloud backup cron job (B2 sync)
          ansible.builtin.cron:
            name: "Cloud backup to B2"
            minute: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[0] }}"
            hour: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[1] }}"
            day: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[2] }}"
            month: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[3] }}"
            weekday: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[4] }}"
            job: "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos >> /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1"
            user: root

        - name: Add iCloud sync cron job
          ansible.builtin.cron:
            name: "iCloud photo sync"
            minute: "{{ icloud_schedule.split()[0] }}"
            hour: "{{ icloud_schedule.split()[1] }}"
            day: "{{ icloud_schedule.split()[2] }}"
            month: "{{ icloud_schedule.split()[3] }}"
            weekday: "{{ icloud_schedule.split()[4] }}"
            job: ". /etc/profile.d/icloud-sync.sh && /usr/local/bin/icloud-sync.sh sync-albums >> /var/log/icloud-sync.log 2>&1"
            user: root

        # =====================================================================
        # Ensure Cron Service is Running
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Ensure cron service is enabled and running
          ansible.builtin.systemd:
            name: cron
            enabled: yes
            state: started

        - name: Display cron configuration
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg:
              - "Cron configured for {{ app_name }}"
              - "  Cloud backup: {{ cloud_schedule }}"
              - "  iCloud sync:  {{ icloud_schedule }}"
  EOT

  inventory = yamlencode({
    lxc = {
      hosts = {
        "immich-importer" = {
          ansible_host = local.ssh_host
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.lxc.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = local.ssh_host
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = "ssh root@${local.ssh_host}"
}

output "cloud_backup_schedule" {
  value = var.cloud_backup_schedule
}

output "icloud_sync_schedule" {
  value = var.icloud_sync_schedule
}

#!/bin/bash
# iCloud Photo Downloader + Immich Import
# Downloads photos from iCloud using icloudpd, then imports to Immich
#
# Usage:
#   icloud-sync.sh download        - Download recent photos (date-based folders)
#   icloud-sync.sh albums          - Download all albums (preserves album structure)
#   icloud-sync.sh albums "Name"   - Download specific album
#   icloud-sync.sh list-albums     - List available iCloud albums
#   icloud-sync.sh import          - Import downloaded photos to Immich
#   icloud-sync.sh sync            - Download recent + Import (quick sync)
#   icloud-sync.sh sync-albums     - Download all albums + Import (full sync)
#   icloud-sync.sh auth            - Authenticate with iCloud (2FA required)
#   icloud-sync.sh status          - Show sync status

set -eu

# Add uv tools to PATH (icloudpd installed via uv tool)
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"

ACTION="${1:-sync}"
ALBUM_ARG="${2:-}"
ICLOUD_DIR="${ICLOUD_DOWNLOAD_DIR:-/downloads/icloud}"
ALBUMS_DIR="${ICLOUD_DIR}/albums"
COOKIE_DIR="/root/.icloudpd"
LOG_FILE="/var/log/icloud-sync.log"
SUCCESS_FILE="/var/log/icloud-last-success"

# Immich settings
IMMICH_SERVER="${IMMICH_SERVER:-http://192.168.1.222:2283}"
IMMICH_API_KEY="${IMMICH_API_KEY:-}"

# ntfy settings
NTFY_SERVER="${NTFY_SERVER:-https://ntfy.homelab.rambtech.dev}"
NTFY_TOPIC="${NTFY_TOPIC:-icloud-sync}"

log() {
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
}

# Send notification via ntfy
notify() {
    local title="$1"
    local message="$2"
    local priority="${3:-default}"
    local tags="${4:-cloud}"

    curl -s -o /dev/null \
        -H "Title: $title" \
        -H "Priority: $priority" \
        -H "Tags: $tags" \
        -d "$message" \
        "$NTFY_SERVER/$NTFY_TOPIC" || true
}

notify_error() {
    local message="$1"
    log "ERROR: $message"
    notify "iCloud Sync Failed" "$message" "high" "warning,icloud"
}

notify_success() {
    local message="$1"
    log "SUCCESS: $message"
    # Only notify success on first sync after a failure, or weekly
    # to avoid notification spam
}

check_auth() {
    if [ ! -d "$COOKIE_DIR" ] || [ -z "$(find "$COOKIE_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
        notify_error "Not authenticated with iCloud. Run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
        log "Run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

authenticate() {
    log "=== iCloud Authentication ==="
    log "This will prompt for 2FA code"
    echo ""

    mkdir -p "$COOKIE_DIR"

    # Interactive authentication
    icloudpd --username "$ICLOUD_USERNAME" \
        --directory "$ICLOUD_DIR" \
        --cookie-directory "$COOKIE_DIR" \
        --auth-only

    log "Authentication complete. Cookies saved to $COOKIE_DIR"
}

download_photos() {
    log "=== Downloading photos from iCloud ==="

    if ! check_auth; then
        return 1
    fi

    mkdir -p "$ICLOUD_DIR"

    log "Download directory: $ICLOUD_DIR"
    log "Starting icloudpd download..."

    # Download with sensible defaults:
    # - Keep original file dates
    # - Download live photos as both photo and video
    # - Use recent photos first (most likely to be new)
    icloudpd --username "$ICLOUD_USERNAME" \
        --directory "$ICLOUD_DIR" \
        --cookie-directory "$COOKIE_DIR" \
        --size original \
        --live-photo-size original \
        --align-raw original \
        --set-exif-datetime \
        --no-progress-bar \
        --recent 500 \
        2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"

    local exit_code=${PIPESTATUS[0]}

    if [ "$exit_code" -eq 0 ]; then
        log "Download complete"
        date > "$SUCCESS_FILE"
    elif [ "$exit_code" -eq 1 ]; then
        notify_error "iCloud 2FA expired or auth error. SSH to immich-importer and run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
    else
        notify_error "iCloud download failed with exit code $exit_code. Check logs: /var/log/icloud-sync.log"
    fi

    return "$exit_code"
}

list_albums() {
    log "=== Listing iCloud Albums ==="

    if ! check_auth; then
        return 1
    fi

    icloudpd --username "$ICLOUD_USERNAME" \
        --cookie-directory "$COOKIE_DIR" \
        --list-albums \
        2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
}

download_album() {
    local album_name="$1"
    local album_dir="$ALBUMS_DIR/$album_name"

    log "Downloading album: $album_name"
    mkdir -p "$album_dir"

    icloudpd --username "$ICLOUD_USERNAME" \
        --directory "$album_dir" \
        --cookie-directory "$COOKIE_DIR" \
        --album "$album_name" \
        --size original \
        --live-photo-size original \
        --align-raw original \
        --set-exif-datetime \
        --no-progress-bar \
        --folder-structure none \
        2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"

    return "${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
}

download_all_albums() {
    log "=== Downloading all iCloud Albums ==="

    if ! check_auth; then
        return 1
    fi

    mkdir -p "$ALBUMS_DIR"

    # Get list of albums (skip header lines and special albums)
    local albums
    albums=$(icloudpd --username "$ICLOUD_USERNAME" \
        --cookie-directory "$COOKIE_DIR" \
        --list-albums 2>/dev/null | \
        grep -v "^Albums:" | \
        grep -v "^Processing" | \
        grep -v "^$" | \
        grep -v "Recently Deleted" | \
        grep -v "Hidden")

    local total=0
    local success=0
    local failed=0

    while IFS= read -r album; do
        [ -z "$album" ] && continue
        total=$((total + 1))
        log "[$total] Downloading album: $album"

        if download_album "$album"; then
            success=$((success + 1))
        else
            failed=$((failed + 1))
            log "WARNING: Failed to download album: $album"
        fi
    done <<< "$albums"

    log "Album download complete: $success succeeded, $failed failed out of $total"

    if [ "$failed" -eq 0 ]; then
        date > "$SUCCESS_FILE"
        return 0
    else
        return 1
    fi
}

import_to_immich() {
    log "=== Importing to Immich ==="

    if [ -z "$IMMICH_API_KEY" ]; then
        log "ERROR: IMMICH_API_KEY not set"
        return 1
    fi

    log "Immich server: $IMMICH_SERVER"

    # Import date-based photos (from download command)
    if [ -d "$ICLOUD_DIR" ] && [ -n "$(find "$ICLOUD_DIR" -maxdepth 3 -type f -name "*.jpg" -o -name "*.heic" -o -name "*.png" -o -name "*.mov" 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ]; then
        log "Importing date-based photos from: $ICLOUD_DIR"
        immich-go -server "$IMMICH_SERVER" \
            -key "$IMMICH_API_KEY" \
            upload "$ICLOUD_DIR" \
            -create-albums \
            -album-name-template "iCloud/{year}/{month}" \
            2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
    fi

    # Import album-based photos (from albums command)
    if [ -d "$ALBUMS_DIR" ]; then
        for album_path in "$ALBUMS_DIR"/*/; do
            [ -d "$album_path" ] || continue
            album_name=$(basename "$album_path")

            if [ -n "$(find "$album_path" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ]; then
                log "Importing album: $album_name"
                immich-go -server "$IMMICH_SERVER" \
                    -key "$IMMICH_API_KEY" \
                    upload "$album_path" \
                    -create-albums \
                    -album-name-template "iCloud Albums/$album_name" \
                    2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
            fi
        done
    fi

    log "Import complete"
}

show_status() {
    echo "=== iCloud Sync Status ==="
    echo ""

    echo "Authentication:"
    if check_auth 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "  Status: Authenticated"
        echo "  Cookies: $COOKIE_DIR"
        ls -la "$COOKIE_DIR" 2>/dev/null | head -5
    else
        echo "  Status: NOT authenticated"
        echo "  Run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
    fi
    echo ""

    echo "Download directory: $ICLOUD_DIR"
    if [ -d "$ICLOUD_DIR" ]; then
        echo "  Size: $(du -sh "$ICLOUD_DIR" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)"
        echo "  Files: $(find "$ICLOUD_DIR" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
    else
        echo "  Directory does not exist"
    fi
    echo ""

    echo "Last successful sync:"
    if [ -f "$SUCCESS_FILE" ]; then
        echo "  $(cat "$SUCCESS_FILE")"
    else
        echo "  Never (or no record)"
    fi
    echo ""

    echo "ntfy notifications:"
    echo "  Server: $NTFY_SERVER"
    echo "  Topic: $NTFY_TOPIC"
    echo ""

    echo "Recent log entries:"
    if [ -f "$LOG_FILE" ]; then
        tail -10 "$LOG_FILE"
    else
        echo "  No logs yet"
    fi
}

full_sync() {
    log "=== Full iCloud Sync ==="

    download_photos || {
        log "Download failed, skipping import"
        return 1
    }

    import_to_immich

    log "=== Sync complete ==="
}

case "$ACTION" in
    download)
        download_photos
        ;;
    albums)
        if [ -n "$ALBUM_ARG" ]; then
            check_auth && download_album "$ALBUM_ARG"
        else
            download_all_albums
        fi
        ;;
    list-albums)
        list_albums
        ;;
    import)
        import_to_immich
        ;;
    sync)
        full_sync
        ;;
    sync-albums)
        log "=== Full Album Sync ==="
        download_all_albums || {
            log "Album download failed, skipping import"
            exit 1
        }
        import_to_immich
        log "=== Album sync complete ==="
        ;;
    auth)
        authenticate
        ;;
    status)
        show_status
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 [command] [options]"
        echo ""
        echo "Commands:"
        echo "  auth           - Authenticate with iCloud (requires 2FA)"
        echo "  download       - Download recent photos (date-based folders)"
        echo "  albums         - Download all albums (preserves album structure)"
        echo "  albums 'Name'  - Download specific album"
        echo "  list-albums    - List available iCloud albums"
        echo "  import         - Import downloaded photos to Immich"
        echo "  sync           - Download recent + Import (quick sync)"
        echo "  sync-albums    - Download all albums + Import (full sync)"
        echo "  status         - Show sync status"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

    DRY_RUN="--dry-run"

sync_photos() {
    echo "=== Syncing photos to B2 - ENCRYPTED ==="

    rclone size $B2_CRYPT 2>/dev/null || echo "not yet synced"
    echo ""
    echo "Local size:"

# =============================================================================
# Documents LXC - Paperless-ngx + Stirling-PDF
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 504
# IP: 10.100.5.104
#
# Document management stack:
# - Paperless-ngx: OCR, full-text search, auto-tagging, email consumption
# - Stirling-PDF: PDF manipulation (merge, split, compress, convert, etc.)
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - Paperless Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "paperless" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "paperless"
}

locals {
  # Flatten paperless section fields into a map by label
  _paperless_section_fields = merge([
    for s in try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.section, []) : {
      for f in try(s.field, []) : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  paperless = {
    admin_user     = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.username, "admin")
    admin_password = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.password, "")
    db_password    = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "db_password", "")
    secret_key     = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "secret_key", "")
  }
}

# Generate the .env file from 1Password secrets + OIDC config
resource "local_sensitive_file" "documents_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Documents Stack Environment
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Paperless-ngx
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${local.paperless.admin_user}
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.admin_password}
PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.db_password}
PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${local.paperless.secret_key}

# OAuth/OIDC via Authentik (django-allauth)
PAPERLESS_SOCIALACCOUNT_PROVIDERS=${jsonencode({
    openid_connect = {
      APPS = [{
        provider_id = "authentik"
        name        = "Authentik"
        client_id   = authentik_provider_oauth2.paperless.client_id
        secret      = random_password.paperless_oidc_secret.result
        settings = {
          server_url = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/paperless/"
        }
      }]
      OAUTH_PKCE_ENABLED = "True"
    }
  })}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 504
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4  # OCR is CPU intensive
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 8192  # OCR needs memory
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 64  # Documents can grow large
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Documents Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "documents"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Ensure .env is generated before file sync
  depends_on = [local_sensitive_file.documents_env]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Documents"
  service_description = "Document management with Paperless-ngx (OCR) and Stirling-PDF (utilities)"

  service_urls = {
    paperless_internal    = "https://docs.${var.domain_internal}"
    paperless_public      = "https://docs.${var.domain_public}"
    stirling_pdf_internal = "https://pdf.${var.domain_internal}"
    stirling_pdf_public   = "https://pdf.${var.domain_public}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Paperless-ngx", port = 8000, info = "Document management with OCR" },
    { name = "Stirling-PDF", port = 8080, info = "PDF manipulation tools" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Paperless database (internal)" },
    { name = "Redis", port = 6379, info = "Paperless cache (internal)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f paperless
cd /config && docker compose logs -f stirling-pdf
```

**Restart services:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart paperless
cd /config && docker compose restart stirling-pdf
```

**Import documents:**
Place files in `/config/consume/` - they'll be automatically imported.

**Export all documents:**
```
cd /config && docker compose exec paperless document_exporter ../export/
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=documents` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["documents", "paperless", "pdf", "ocr"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.documents.container_id
  container_ip   = module.documents.ip_address
  container_name = "documents"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "daily"
    retention = "7"
    namespace = "lxc-504"

    pre_backup_commands = [{
      name    = "PostgreSQL dump (Paperless)"
      command = "docker exec paperless-db pg_dump -U paperless -d paperless --clean --if-exists | gzip > /config/paperless-db-backup.sql.gz"
      timeout = 300
    }]

    include_paths = ["/config", "/var/lib/docker/volumes"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,documents,paperless"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["documents"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["documents"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Paperless-ngx route (internal only)
module "paperless_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "docs"
  backend_url = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "docs.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "docs.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# Stirling-PDF route (internal only)
module "stirling_pdf_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "pdf"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "pdf.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "pdf.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]
  public_middlewares   = ["cloudflare-https", "security-headers", "authentik"]
  public_entrypoint    = ["web"]

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.documents.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.documents.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.documents.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    direct_paperless      = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8000"
    paperless_internal    = module.paperless_route.internal_url
    paperless_public      = module.paperless_route.public_url

    direct_stirling_pdf   = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8080"
    stirling_pdf_internal = module.stirling_pdf_route.internal_url
    stirling_pdf_public   = module.stirling_pdf_route.public_url

# Shared Configuration
# =============================================================================
# This file is symlinked into each app directory to provide common variables
# and provider configuration. Each app has its own state file.
#
# Secret Management:

# - All other secrets: Fetched from 1Password via onepassword provider
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# State Encryption (Required as TF_VAR - runs before providers)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "state_encryption_passphrase" {
  description = "Passphrase for encrypting state files (from 1Password: op://homelab/opentofu/password)"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Configuration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "proxmox_node" {
  description = "Proxmox node name"
  type        = string
  default     = "pve"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SSH Configuration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "ssh_private_key_path" {
  description = "Path to SSH private key"
  type        = string
  default     = "~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519"
}

variable "ssh_public_key_path" {
  description = "Path to SSH public key"
  type        = string
  default     = "~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519.pub"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Storage & Network Defaults
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "default_storage" {
  description = "Default storage for LXC containers"
  type        = string
  default     = "tank"
}

variable "default_bridge" {
  description = "Default network bridge"
  type        = string
  default     = "vmbr0"
}

variable "lxc_template" {
  description = "Default LXC template (base Debian)"
  type        = string
  default     = "local:vztmpl/debian-13-standard_13.1-2_amd64.tar.zst"
}

variable "lxc_template_docker" {
  description = "LXC template with Docker pre-installed"
  type        = string
  default     = "local:vztmpl/debian-13-docker_1.0_amd64.tar.zst"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Domain Configuration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "domain_internal" {
  description = "Internal domain suffix"
  type        = string
  default     = "homelab.rambtech.dev"

  validation {
    condition     = can(regex("^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]+[a-z0-9]$", var.domain_internal))
    error_message = "Internal domain must be a valid domain name (e.g., homelab.example.com)."
  }
}

variable "domain_public" {
  description = "Public domain"
  type        = string
  default     = "rambtech.dev"

  validation {
    condition     = can(regex("^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]+[a-z0-9]$", var.domain_public))
    error_message = "Public domain must be a valid domain name (e.g., example.com)."
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cloudflare Configuration (IDs only - tokens from 1Password)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "cloudflare_account_id" {
  description = "Cloudflare account ID"
  type        = string
  default     = ""
}

variable "cloudflare_zone_id" {
  description = "Cloudflare zone ID"
  type        = string
  default     = ""
}

variable "cloudflare_tunnel_id" {
  description = "Cloudflare tunnel ID"
  type        = string
  default     = ""
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DNS Mode Configuration (Home/Travel)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "dns_mode" {
  description = "DNS resolution mode: 'home' uses LAN IPs (192.168.1.x), 'travel' uses container IPs (10.100.x.x) for Tailscale routing"
  type        = string
  default     = "home"

  validation {
    condition     = contains(["home", "travel"], var.dns_mode)
    error_message = "dns_mode must be either 'home' or 'travel'"
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Computed Locals
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

locals {
  ssh_public_key = file(var.ssh_public_key_path)

  # Proxmox connection settings based on dns_mode
  # - home: Use LAN IP (192.168.1.215) for direct access
  # - travel: Use container gateway IP (10.100.0.1) routable via Tailscale
  proxmox_lan_ip       = "192.168.1.215"
  proxmox_container_ip = "10.100.0.1"

  proxmox_host     = var.dns_mode == "travel" ? local.proxmox_container_ip : local.proxmox_lan_ip
  proxmox_endpoint = "https://${local.proxmox_host}:8006"
  proxmox_ssh_host = local.proxmox_host
}

     3→# =============================================================================
     4→# Central registry of all static IP allocations in the homelab.
     5→# This file serves as the single source of truth for IP assignments.
     6→#
     7→# Network Architecture:
     8→#   - 192.168.1.0/24 (vmbr0): Home LAN - FIOS router, external access
     9→#   - 10.100.0.0/16  (vmbr1): Container network - internal services
    10→#
    11→# IP Scheme (Container ID aligned with IP):
    12→#   - 10.100.1.x:  Core services (LXC 100-149)
    13→#   - 10.100.2.x:  Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249)
    14→#   - 10.100.3.x:  Media - Photos (LXC 300-349)
    15→#   - 10.100.4.x:  Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449)
    16→#   - 10.100.5.x:  Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549)
    17→#
    18→# Dual-NIC Services (need 192.168.1.x for LAN compatibility):
    19→#   - Traefik: Reverse proxy for LAN clients
    20→#   - AdGuard: DNS for LAN devices
    21→#   - Jellyfin: DLNA/casting
    22→#   - Immich: Mobile app sync
    23→# =============================================================================
    24→
    25→locals {
    26→  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    27→  # Network Configuration
    28→  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    29→  network = {
    30→    # Home LAN (vmbr0)
    31→    lan_gateway = "192.168.1.1"
    32→    lan_netmask = "/24"
    33→    lan_prefix  = "192.168.1"
    34→
    35→    # Container network (vmbr1)
    36→    container_gateway = "10.100.0.1"
    37→    container_netmask = "/16"
    38→    container_prefix  = "10.100"
    39→  }
    40→
    41→  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    42→  # IP Registry - Container Network (10.100.x.x)
    43→  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    44→  # Pattern: 10.100.<category>.<container_id_suffix>
    45→  # Example: LXC 304 -> 10.100.3.104 (category 3, suffix 04)
    46→
    47→  ip_registry = {
    48→    # Infrastructure (192.168.1.x only - not containers)
    49→    infrastructure = {
    50→      router  = "192.168.1.1"    # Verizon FIOS router
    51→      proxmox = "192.168.1.215"  # Proxmox VE host (vmbr0)
    52→      # Proxmox also has 10.100.0.1 on vmbr1 (gateway for containers)
    53→    }

# =============================================================================
# IP Address Registry
# =============================================================================
# Central registry of all static IP allocations in the homelab.
# This file serves as the single source of truth for IP assignments.
#
# Network Architecture:
#   - 192.168.1.0/24 (vmbr0): Home LAN - FIOS router, external access
#   - 10.100.0.0/16  (vmbr1): Container network - internal services
#
# IP Scheme (Container ID aligned with IP):
#   - 10.100.1.x:  Core services (LXC 100-149)
#   - 10.100.2.x:  Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249)
#   - 10.100.3.x:  Media - Photos (LXC 300-349)
#   - 10.100.4.x:  Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449)
#   - 10.100.5.x:  Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549)
#
# Dual-NIC Services (need 192.168.1.x for LAN compatibility):
#   - Traefik: Reverse proxy for LAN clients
#   - AdGuard: DNS for LAN devices
#   - Jellyfin: DLNA/casting
#   - Immich: Mobile app sync
# =============================================================================

locals {
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network Configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  network = {
    # Home LAN (vmbr0)
    lan_gateway = "192.168.1.1"
    lan_netmask = "/24"
    lan_prefix  = "192.168.1"

    # Container network (vmbr1)
    container_gateway = "10.100.0.1"
    container_netmask = "/16"
    container_prefix  = "10.100"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IP Registry - Container Network (10.100.x.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pattern: 10.100.<category>.<container_id_suffix>
  # Example: LXC 304 -> 10.100.3.104 (category 3, suffix 04)

  ip_registry = {
    # Infrastructure (192.168.1.x only - not containers)
    infrastructure = {
      router  = "192.168.1.1"    # Verizon FIOS router
      proxmox = "192.168.1.215"  # Proxmox VE host (vmbr0)
      # Proxmox also has 10.100.0.1 on vmbr1 (gateway for containers)
    }

    # Core services (LXC 100-149) -> 10.100.1.x
    core = {
      network_services = "10.100.1.101"  # LXC 101 - AdGuard DNS + Tailscale
      pbs              = "10.100.1.102"  # LXC 102 - Proxmox Backup Server
      # 103 reserved for monitoring migration from 500
      container_mgmt   = "10.100.1.104"  # LXC 104 - Pulse + Arcane
    }

    # Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249) -> 10.100.2.x
    dashboards = {
      traefik    = "10.100.2.200"  # LXC 200 - Reverse proxy
      dashboards = "10.100.2.201"  # LXC 201 - Homepage + Dashy
      # LXC 202 - Available (was Authelia, destroyed 2025-12-24)
      authentik  = "10.100.2.203"  # LXC 203 - Identity Provider
    }

    # Media - Photos (LXC 300-349) -> 10.100.3.x
    photos = {
      immich_importer = "10.100.3.103"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
      immich          = "10.100.3.104"  # LXC 304 - Photo management
    }

    # Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449) -> 10.100.4.x
    media = {
      jellyfin         = "10.100.4.101"  # LXC 401 - Media server + Jellystat
      media_management = "10.100.4.102"  # LXC 402 - Arr stack
    }

    # Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549) -> 10.100.5.x
    monitoring = {
      monitoring    = "10.100.5.100"  # LXC 500 - Prometheus, Grafana, etc
      openwebui     = "10.100.5.101"  # LXC 501 - AI chat
      n8n           = "10.100.5.102"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
      obsidian_sync = "10.100.5.103"  # LXC 503 - Obsidian LiveSync (CouchDB)
      documents     = "10.100.5.104"  # LXC 504 - Paperless-ngx + Stirling-PDF
    }
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # LAN IPs for Dual-NIC Services (192.168.1.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # These services need direct LAN access for compatibility with home devices

  lan_ips = {
    traefik          = "192.168.1.235"  # LXC 200 - LAN clients access services
    # 192.168.1.225 - Available (was Authelia LXC 202)
    dashboards       = "192.168.1.234"  # LXC 201 - Homepage + Dashy
    network_services = "192.168.1.196"  # LXC 101 - DNS for LAN devices
    jellyfin         = "192.168.1.226"  # LXC 401 - DLNA/casting
    immich           = "192.168.1.222"  # LXC 304 - Mobile app sync
    immich_importer  = "192.168.1.223"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
    monitoring       = "192.168.1.229"  # LXC 500 - Monitoring stack
    openwebui        = "192.168.1.221"  # LXC 501 - AI chat
    n8n              = "192.168.1.213"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Container ID to IP Mapping
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  container_ips = {
    # Core (100-149)
    101 = local.ip_registry.core.network_services
    102 = local.ip_registry.core.pbs
    104 = local.ip_registry.core.container_mgmt

    # Dashboards & Auth (200-249)
    200 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik
    201 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.dashboards
    # 202 - Available (was Authelia)
    203 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik

    # Photos (300-349)
    303 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich_importer
    304 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich

    # Media (400-449)
    401 = local.ip_registry.media.jellyfin
    402 = local.ip_registry.media.media_management

    # Monitoring & AI (500-549)
    500 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring
    501 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.openwebui
    502 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.n8n
    503 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync
    504 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper: Get IP with CIDR notation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in merge(
      local.ip_registry.core,
      local.ip_registry.dashboards,
      local.ip_registry.photos,
      local.ip_registry.media,
      local.ip_registry.monitoring,
    ) : name => "${ip}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  }

  lan_ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in local.lan_ips : name => "${ip}${local.network.lan_netmask}"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Convenience: Traefik IP for route modules
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Used by traefik-route modules to sync config to Traefik LXC via SSH
  # - home mode: Use LAN IP (192.168.1.x) for direct access
  # - travel mode: Use container IP (10.100.x.x) routable via Tailscale
  traefik_ip = var.dns_mode == "travel" ? local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik : local.lan_ips.traefik

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Flatten all allocated IPs for validation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  _all_container_ips = concat(
    values(local.ip_registry.core),
    values(local.ip_registry.dashboards),
    values(local.ip_registry.photos),
    values(local.ip_registry.media),
    values(local.ip_registry.monitoring),
  )

  _all_lan_ips = values(local.lan_ips)
}

# =============================================================================
# Outputs for CLI Usage
# =============================================================================

output "container_ips" {
  description = "All container IPs (10.100.x.x)"
  value       = local._all_container_ips
}

output "lan_ips" {
  description = "LAN IPs for dual-NIC services (192.168.1.x)"
  value       = local.lan_ips
}

output "ip_registry" {
  description = "Full IP registry organized by category"
  value       = local.ip_registry
}

output "network" {
  description = "Network configuration"
  value       = local.network
}
